summary: Frontend E2E testing of the PHP 'Long Live Men' preview via public URL (desktop 1920 + mobile 390). Tested all GET routes for status/PHP errors (none), home slider/product/variants/FAQs, all nav + footer policy links, product gallery thumb swaps (15 thumbs incl. 2 videos), add-to-cart/update/remove with header count, buy-now -> checkout server validation -> COD order -> confirmation, register/account/address/profile/order history/logout/login, contact -> admin messages (mark read), track order (logged-in redirect, guest email link via mail.log, track view shows status+tracking), admin login/dashboard stats/orders filter/export CSV/status update/tracking save/product edit save/reviews/settings save/logout, 404 pages. FOUND & FIXED one CRITICAL bug: ALL logins (customer register/login and admin login) failed in a real browser - user was bounced back to /login. After fix everything passed.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: after register/login (customer & admin) browser was redirected to /login - session lost. Preview proxy rewrites Set-Cookie with 'SameSite=None; Partitioned'; when session_regenerate_id(true) issues a new llm_session cookie, Chromium keeps the old one too (2 llm_session cookies), sends the stale one first, PHP strict mode finds the destroyed session -> new empty session. curl was unaffected, only real browsers.

PHP uses date_default_timezone Asia/Kolkata but MySQL NOW()/CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is UTC (SYSTEM). Order created_at shown as '24 Oct 2026, 08:01 PM' while order number is LLM-261025-..., mail log/export filename show 25 Oct 01:31 IST. Also token expiry comparisons mix PHP date() (IST) with SQL NOW() (UTC), e.g. password_reset/track tokens live 5.5h longer.

issues: Slides have different aspect ratios so hero height jumps (~745px vs ~640px) between slides, causing layout shift of content below
Preview notice + announcement bar take ~130px at 390px width before the header; consider shortening on mobile
Auto-generated labels 'Seo title', 'Seo description' should read 'SEO'

action_items: Review tester fix in /app/site/app/Core/Session.php: regenerate() and 30-min id rotation are skipped when APP_ENV=local (preview). Keep it for preview; for production keep regeneration (no Partitioned-rewriting proxy there).
Align DB timezone: run SET time_zone = '+05:30' on PDO connect (or use UTC everywhere) so displayed order/message timestamps and token expiry are consistent
Optional: fix hero slider fixed aspect-ratio to avoid layout shift
Optional: sitemap.xml <loc> values are relative ('/shop') because APP_URL is empty - should be absolute URLs
critical_code_review_comments: Session::regenerate + use_strict_mode breaks behind a proxy that adds Partitioned to cookies; root cause of auth failure
Mixed time sources: PHP date() in IST written to DATETIME columns (expires_at) while other columns use SQL NOW() in UTC
Track form always shows the same generic success flash even for unknown order numbers (good for enumeration safety, intended)

rca of the issue: Repro: open /admin/login in Chromium via public URL, log in with valid creds -> 302 /admin -> 302 /admin/login. Network: POST sets llm_session=NEW (Partitioned added by proxy) but subsequent requests send 'llm_session=OLD' first; context.cookies() shows two llm_session entries. session_regenerate_id(true) deleted OLD's data and strict mode issues a fresh id each request. Mitigation applied: skip regenerate when APP_ENV=local. Verified: customer register->account, login, logout, admin login all work.
